matched_within_job_9763.limitation: Paired repeats on one selected workload; ranges are observed run ranges, not confidence intervals.

matching_reported_configuration: One RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell Max-Q; different physical GPU UUIDs
17981 KV blocks; 512-token chunked prefill; prefix caching enabled
83 request identities and per-request prompt/output lengths match the committed repeat-0 timeline
4894853 prompt tokens; 15235 output tokens per run
important_differences: 9763: three repeats, rotating order; 10779: one run per policy
9763 CacheWise runner retains fork default 30-second aging override; 10779 prefix-aware cases explicitly disable it
9763 includes an additional InferCept policy patch; 10779 does not
9763 InferCept uses elapsed pause duration and profiled recompute cost with preserve/discard, no swapping; it is not the moving-average eviction baseline described in the CacheWise paper
Committed 9763 audits verify hashes within that job but do not expose per-request hashes for independent cross-job hash validation
metric_definition: Cached prompt tokens divided by total prompt tokens from completed request usage; not cache-lookup hit counters
interpretation: InferCept beats the older CacheWise configuration in its own matched experiment. New no-aging CacheWise and prefix-aware LRU have lower reported times, but their comparison to InferCept is cross-job and does not replace a fresh three-way controlled experiment.
